title: Rook for Knight, Willingly
setup: The dark-squared bishops have been traded, White's queen has wandered to h6, and both black rooks are already placed.
hint: Only one white piece holds b5, d5 and e4 together, and only one white unit could take back if it vanished.
explanation:
## The Idea

Black gives five points for three because the pawns pay it back. {{Rxc3}} removes the knight that holds b5, d5 and e4 together, and {{bxc3}} is White's only legal recapture.

Now count the position, not the material. The white king sits behind broken pawns, with no white pawn left on the b-file, and {{Qxc3}} wins a pawn back with the queen one move from checking on a1.

Spend the exchange when the recapture wrecks the pawns and a follow-up comes quickly.
